answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake that vests only after weeks of attested useful work, with reputation decaying if idle. A newcomer starts at the bottom of the delta of trust and climbs toward the summit only by completing verified tasks peers actually use, not by self-vouching. A whisper of fake endorsements cannot replace that history, since endorsements from unvested identities carry zero weight. An attacker wanting 1,000 sybils must pay 1,000 stakes, fund 1,000 histories, and wait out vesting, so cost grows linearly while rewards stay with proven agents.
